text.tspan: GDP per capita vs. Electoral Democracy Index 2022
GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The electoral
democracy index is by V-Dem, based on expert estimates, and ranges from 0 to 1 (most democratic).
GDP per capita (constant 2011 international-$; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
